tool_args.rationale: The paid observations carry the high-frequency sign-oscillation signature. Under the prescribed decision rule, the appropriate outcome is scoped abstention rather than fitting or purchasing another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot already reports high-frequency sign oscillation, which triggers scoped abstention.
The reported oscillation signature makes a stationary smooth forecast unsupported.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to identifying the forecast law.
